name: fem adaptive: an 80 × 40 × 10 steel plate with a 12 mm hole
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); await m.actions.closeProject({ force: true }); await m.actions.newDocument('part', { blank: true }); await sleep(300); const { itemsToSketch } = await import('/src/cad/cad2d-import.js'); const { createFeature } = await import('/src/cad/features.js'); m.actions.change('op.feature', (p) => { const part = p.parts.find((x) => x.id === p.active.id); const { sketch } = itemsToSketch([{ kind: 'line', a: [0, 0], b: [80, 0] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 0], b: [80, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [80, 40], b: [0, 40] }, { kind: 'line', a: [0, 40], b: [0, 0] }, { kind: 'circle', c: [20, 20], r: 6 }]); const sk = createFeature(part, 'sketch', { plane: { kind: 'std', name: 'top' }, ...sketch }); part.features.push(sk, createFeature(part, 'extrude', { sketch: sk.id, depth: 10 })); }); await sleep(1200); await m.run('simulation'); await sleep(300); return JSON.stringify({ mode: m.state.editing?.mode, cyl: m.state.partEntry.faces.filter((f) => /CYL/.test(f.geomType)).length }); })()

name: fem adaptive: the option shows its fields; pulled from the end with the start fixed, the passes lower the error and fill the table and report
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; const off = Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="adaptiveTarget"]')); m.actions.pmToggle('fem.adaptive', true); await sleep(100); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('adaptiveTarget', '2'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('adaptivePasses', '3'); await sleep(100); const fields = ['adaptiveTarget', 'adaptivePasses'].every((k) => document.querySelector(`[data-pm-field="${k}"]`)); e.loadKind = 'force'; e.dir = 'x'; e.magnitude = 20000; e.elementSize = 6; e.fixtures = [mk(at('x', 0), 'fixed')]; e.loads = [mk(at('x', 80))]; e.result = null; const r = await run(); await sleep(200); const h = r?.adaptive?.history ?? []; const rows = document.querySelectorAll('.fem-adaptive-table tr').length; const rep = m.fem ? '' : ''; return JSON.stringify({ off, fields, ok: r?.ok, passes: h.length, falls: h.every((x, i) => i === 0 || (x.error < h[i - 1].error && x.elements > h[i - 1].elements)), rows: rows === h.length + 1, e: h.map((x) => +(100 * x.error).toFixed(2)) }); })()

name: fem adaptive: p-adaptive — linear then quadratic tetrahedra on one mesh, the passes listed with their order
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; m.actions.pmSet('fem.adaptiveMethod', 'p'); m.actions.pmFieldChanged('adaptiveTarget', '50'); await sleep(100); e.result = null; const r = await run(); await sleep(200); const h = r?.adaptive?.history ?? []; return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, method: r?.adaptive?.method, orders: h.map((x) => x.order).join(','), rows: document.querySelectorAll('.fem-adaptive-table tr').length === h.length + 1 }); })()

name: fem adaptive: switched off, a plain run has no passes
eval: (async () => { const m = window.__mymechanics; const sleep = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); const faces = m.state.partEntry.faces; const all = faces.map((f, index) => ({ f, index })); const mk = (x, kind) => ({ index: x.index, faceId: x.f.hashCode, type: x.f.geomType, ...(kind ? { kind } : {}) }); const planes = all.filter((x) => x.f.geomType === 'PLANE'); const at = (c, v) => planes.find((x) => Math.abs(x.f.center[c] - v) < 1e-6); const run = async () => { await m.actions.pmCommand('runSim'); for (let i = 0; i < 800 && !m.state.editing.result; i++) await sleep(150); return m.state.editing.result; }; const e = m.state.editing; m.actions.pmToggle('fem.adaptive', false); await sleep(100); e.result = null; const r = await run(); return JSON.stringify({ ok: r?.ok, adaptive: Boolean(r?.adaptive), field: Boolean(document.querySelector('[data-pm-field="adaptiveTarget"]')) }); })()
